title: Preserve approval-required policy semantics
goal: Ensure M6 treats requiresApproval as a distinct approval workflow and does not confuse it with an explicit policy denial.
context: PolicyDecision.approve intentionally sets allowed=false and requiresApproval=true. A prior audit incorrectly treated that shape as a denial, which would bypass the configured ApprovalGate. Explicit denial is represented by PolicyDecision.deny with requiresApproval=false.
forbidden_changes: Do not skip ApprovalGate when PolicyDecision.requiresApproval is true.
Do not allow PolicyDecision.deny to invoke the approval gate or execute a capability.
Do not infer approval intent from summary strings.
acceptance_criteria: PolicyDecision.approve requests the configured approval gate and can proceed only if that gate approves.
PolicyDecision.deny remains denied and does not call the approval gate.
Approval audit events preserve typed Skill identity through request and resolution.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Preserve the defined PolicyDecision.approve contract, keep explicit deny separate, and test both cases end-to-end.
